title: Tongue-twister boosters: narration-modeled, sound-mode tracking, sparkle celebration (Unit 14)
accept: Flow (transcribed): booster node opened → recorded narration models the twister (owner-supplied audio ref) BEFORE listening begins → child reads with green-word tracking → playful sparkle celebration; narration-before-listening asserted via FakeAudioService + tracker start ordering.

Tracking uses SOUND-LEVEL matching (ratified): the matcher runs in sound mode against the twister's phoneme sequence with the drilled targetPhonemeId's instances weighted most; producing the sounds advances the tracker even if word recognition would fail (scripted phone-hypothesis test); where the engine exposes only word hypotheses, the sound-mode approximation path is used (scripted word-hypothesis test).
Word tracking uses the twister threshold set, not the story set — asserted via matcher config injection (transcribed acceptance).

Completion writes TwisterProgress (timesCompleted incremented) and grants NO collectible (collectibles remain story-tied; no_collectible_test asserts CollectionState untouched — transcribed acceptance).
twister_started and twister_completed analytics emitted (recording fake).

Optional second pass: after completion, a 'say it again — a little faster!' prompt offers ONE replay round; purely optional and skippable; no extra reward; its completion is NOT required for the node to be marked done (transcribed acceptance tests: offered once, skippable, done-state independent).
Sparkle celebration is playful but distinct from story celebration: no Rive story artboard, no collectible flight (widget test).
Twisters are always replayable (re-entry allowed after completion; timesCompleted increments).
pinned_design: Unit 14 pinned: a TongueTwister is an enunciation booster distinct from stories — goal is clear, confident speech, not decoding; each targets one phoneme and is alliterative around it. Flow: node opened → narration models it (owner-supplied recording) → child reads with green-word tracking driven by sound-level matching (ratified: matcher listens for the SOUNDS, not word identity — phoneme sequence is the target, drilled phoneme weighted most); thresholds are a separate looser set in the tuning file (practice saying, not proof of decoding) → playful sparkle celebration; no collectible; completion recorded in TwisterProgress. Sound mode consumes phone-level hypotheses from the Unit 4 engine interface; word-hypothesis-only engines are approximated by phonetic-distance scoring (whether platform engines expose phone detail is a Unit 0 spike question). Optional single 'faster' second pass, skippable, no extra reward. Placement on the map (≈1 per 3 stories, level-tagged, unlocked with level, always replayable) is rendered by progress-map-collection; pack validation (narration + targetPhonemeId required, decodability exempt) is pack-build-cli's.
notes: Fully headless via FakeReadingTracker/FakeAsrEngine + FakeAudioService + in-memory Drift. Reuses word-state-machine for green-word visual tracking and word-matcher's sound_mode_scorer — do not fork matcher logic. Twister threshold DEFAULT VALUES are OPEN (OPEN-DECISIONS): implement against tuning-file placeholders. If the Unit 0 spike verdict reports no usable phone-level detail, the approximation path becomes the primary on-device path — flag to orchestrator when the verdict lands.
